{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
print("First 5 values of revenue:")
print(data['revenue'].head())

# Check if any revenue values contain commas
has_commas = data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"Number of revenue entries with commas: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Check for QA orders with '999,999.99' format
qa_orders_comma = data[data['revenue'] == '999,999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = '999,999.99'): {len(qa_orders_comma)}")

# Also check if any have '999999.99' but with commas in the string
# Look for any revenue values that are '999,999.99' or '999999.99'
qa_orders_any = data[data['revenue'].str.contains('999,999.99|999999.99', na=False)]
print(f"Number of QA orders (any format): {len(qa_orders_any)}")

# Show the actual values of any such rows
print("\nActual values of suspected QA orders:")
print(qa_orders_any[['revenue', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'status']])"}
